cand.title: Congreso Centroamericano de Avicultura 2027
cand.excerpt: Ranked on explicit dates and lodging/meeting mechanism, then reduced for named incumbent or unconfirmed accessibility.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Gregory Marte, ADA executive director, is the strongest organizer-access lead because he directly discusses 2027 preparations. Pavel Concepción, ADA president for the published 2025–2026 term and identified as president again in October 2026, is a senior institutional introduction route. Neither is verified as the individual hotel-contract signatory or accommodation buyer; no independent 2027 PCO/DMC was verified.
findings.futureEdition: Verified activity dates: 15–18 September 2027 in Punta Cana, Dominican Republic. Engormix’s 7 October 2026 interview with ADA executive director Gregory Marte explicitly gives these activity dates; 7 October is the publication date, not the congress date. This edition falls within the requested horizon. A 21 October 2026 Engormix announcement describes a forthcoming official attendee/company platform. No edition number is assigned here without evidence.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using published product and historical congress scale: Wyndham Alltra is unsuitable as sole host if 2027 resembles the 2025 congress. Wyndham publishes 620 rooms, 380 m² of meeting space, three event facilities and capacities of 300 conference/200 banquet guests; ANAVIP reports over 2,000 participants and over 9,000 m² of exhibition in 2025. A guestroom-led delegation, exhibitor/sponsor subgroup, smaller meeting or pre/post stay could fit the all-inclusive Uvero Alto product, subject to confirmed requirements and transport. These are proposed uses, not published demand.
findings.venueCommitments: No named 2027 congress venue or host hotel verified. The announcement refers to confirmation of sede in Punta Cana but does not name a property or disclose a contract. Country/city selection is not proof of a hotel commitment. No evidence supports labeling this event committed to a named competing hotel.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented sequence: 2016 Antigua Guatemala, Hotel Casa Santo Domingo; 2018 San Pedro Sula, Honduras, venue not verified in the source reviewed; 2023 San Antonio de Belén/San José area, Costa Rica, Sala de Exposiciones Pedregal; 2025 Panama City, Panama Convention Center; 2027 Punta Cana announced. Sources describe a biennial regional congress and rotating federation leadership/host selection. The 2018–2023 gap means this is not proof of uninterrupted biennial delivery, still less annual Punta Cana demand.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 hotel sourcing status is unconfirmed, not open or closed. No verified lodging RFP, official hotel list, room block, rate code, booking agency, PCO/DMC or accommodation-booking portal was located for 2027. ADA’s executive office is the verified inquiry route. Historically, 2023 advertised four nearby host hotels and 2025 advertised hotels near the convention center; those historical arrangements establish neither 2027 inventory nor availability. The old 2025 congress domain currently contains unrelated/spam-like content and must not be used as a trusted 2027 booking channel.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-led poultry industry congress, not a travel-trade intermediary business. ADA is the Dominican industry association/local institutional organizer route; FEDAVICAC is the regional federation behind the congress series. Historical host associations include ANAVI Guatemala and ANAVIP Panama. Engormix is a media/dissemination platform, not evidence of hotel purchasing authority. No agency/PCO/DMC role is established for 2027.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No 2027 incumbent hotel, sellout, overflow requirement or room-block shortage verified. Historical exhibition/plenary scale is the material limitation, not demonstrated competitor displacement. The actual venue location and acceptable transfer time remain unknown; Punta Cana alone does not establish convenient access from Uvero Alto. Cap Cana, La Romana and Bayahibe are not treated as local hotel demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Gregory Marte through ADA’s published executive-office channel, direccionejecutiva@ada.org.do / 809-222-9344. Ask for the named 2027 venue, any appointed congress secretariat/PCO, lodging-contract owner, official booking-platform link, room-block commitments and whether independent delegation or sponsor groups may source accommodation. Request room-night pattern and transfer requirements before quoting. Present 620-room all-inclusive accommodation and smaller group capability, not a full-congress hosting offer. Use Pavel Concepción for institutional introduction if needed; reconfirm his role after the published 2025–2026 term. Hold sales qualification until ADA confirms an accessible pathway.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the target 2027 edition, organizer relationship access is available through ADA, but access to hotel sourcing is unknown. Do not publish as an open RFP, available room block or confirmed overflow lead. Dates and destination are confirmed by the organizer interview; lodging eligibility is not. Historical 2025 hotels are not current opportunities.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: develop a recurring association relationship and compete for suitable delegation/sponsor lodging or smaller associated programmes, rather than assuming capture of the whole congress. Regional rotation means later editions need not return to Punta Cana; no post-2027 Dominican edition or date is verified.
